grid_definition.road_mask_source: TIGER/2016/Roads (S1100 interstates + S1200 US highways, 5km buffer)

slope_deg.desc: Terrain slope — 5°+ doubles truck fuel consumption

no2_mol_m2.desc: Tropospheric NO₂ — diesel emissions, corridor saturation

so2_mol_m2.desc: SO₂ — fuel quality and industrial pollution

co_mol_m2.desc: CO — stop-and-go traffic proxy, incomplete combustion

temperature_k.desc: Surface air temp — engine efficiency, A/C load

wind_u_ms.desc: Eastward wind 10m — headwind drag on trucks

precip_mm.desc: Precipitation — traction loss, speed reduction, safety risk

snow_cover.desc: Snow cover NDSI — road closures, chain requirements

aod.desc: Aerosol Optical Depth — air quality along corridor
